summary: Caylus 1303 is a streamlined reimagining of the classic worker-placement game Caylus, where players place workers to gather resources and construct buildings while competing for limited action slots. It trims the complexity of the original into a faster, more accessible but still meaty euro experience.
praised: successfully modernizes and speeds up the classic Caylus formula
good variability from modular setup and characters
faster playtime than the original while retaining depth
criticised: loses some of the depth/crunch fans of the original wanted
still has a learning curve for newcomers
some feel it's a lesser echo of the 2005 original

interaction.kind: worker placement blocking and competition for limited actions

scoring.why: victory points come from buildings built, resources banked, and favor with the provost/king mechanisms
